links.outcome: Sensitivity of PS4 counting concordance to prompt refinements across five LLMs
links.effect: Prompt refinements improved concordance for most models but reduced performance for Claude Sonnet 4, indicating performance is model- and prompt-dependent.
links.quote: Prompt refinements improved concordance for most models but reduced performance for Claude Sonnet 4, indicating model specific prompting may be warranted.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid workflow with LLM evidence extraction and expert escalation for genetic variant curation

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of multiple commercial LLMs on extracting variant evidence and case counts from scientific literature against an expert-curated ground truth dataset.
